column1: 23166§computerize§kəmˈpjuːtəraɪz§It's reported that 80% of sections in the company have been completely computerized.§据报道，该公司80%的部门已经完全**计算机化**了。§
23167§popularize§ˈpɒpjələraɪz§The Internet has an important role to play in popularizing new scientific knowledge and spreading new information.§网络在**普及**新的科学知识以及传播新信息方面起着重要的作用。§改例句：Internet 前缺冠词 the
23168§devalue§ˌdiːˈvæljuː§Let's not devalue his work unjustly.§我们不要不公正地**贬低**他的工作。§
23169§ferry§ˈferi§In Venice, which is famous as the city of water, the children there need to be ferried between school and home every day.§在著名的水城威尼斯，孩子们每天都要**乘船**来往于学校和家之间。§
23170§iron§ˈaɪən§It will take me about half an hour to iron that dress.§**烫平**那条连衣裙，我大概要花上半个小时的时间。§
23171§bully§ˈbʊli§When confronted with bullying and threats, some people will choose to give in or keep silent.§当面对**恐吓**和威胁时，一些人选择屈服或沉默。§
23172§storyline§ˈstɔːrilaɪn§The pure, innocent love of a young couple became the main storyline of this film.§一对年轻夫妻纯真无瑕的爱情是这部电影的主要**故事情节**。§
23173§orbit§ˈɔːbɪt§There have been hundreds of satellites put into orbit round the earth this year.§今年数以百计的人造卫星被送入环绕地球的**轨道**。§
23174§combat§ˈkɒmbæt§The state government is spending millions of dollars in its attempt to combat gun abuse.§州政府花费数百万美元试图**防止**滥用枪支。§
23175§slothful§ˈsləʊθfl§The white-collar workers in big cities tend to suffer from fatigue easily which makes them slothful in the office.§大城市的白领阶层往往容易患上疲劳症，使他们在工作中反应**迟钝**。§
23176§catastrophic§ˌkætəˈstrɒfɪk§The effects of global warming, while not immediate, are potentially catastrophic.§全球气温上升的后果虽然并非即时发生，但可能潜伏着**大灾难**。§
23177§abide§əˈbaɪd§Anyone can abide by what he or she said, but it doesn't mean all of them are correct.§任何人都可以**坚持**自己所说的话，但这并不意味着他们全都是正确的。§
23178§allure§əˈlʊə(r)§According to the statistics, the allure of the big city has weakened because of high housing prices.§数据显示，高房价降低了大城市的**吸引力**。§
23179§oxygen§ˈɒksɪdʒən§Oxygen masks are used by the scientists for a shortage of oxygen at the top of the mountain.§由于山顶缺氧，科学家需要戴**氧气**罩。§
23180§pervasive§pəˈveɪsɪv§Ageism is pervasive and entrenched in our society.§年龄歧视在我们的社会中非常**普遍**，而且根深蒂固。§
23181§encroach§ɪnˈkrəʊtʃ§It has been proved that human activities have encroached upon the survival of the creatures in nature.§经证实，人类的活动已经**侵害**了自然界中生物的生存。§
23182§fantastic§fænˈtæstɪk§Kids like spending a great deal of pocket money on fantastic toys instead of useful books.§孩子们喜欢花大量的零花钱购买**奇特**的玩具，而不是有用的书籍。§

23183§abhorrent§əbˈhɒrənt§As far as I'm concerned, the practice of killing rare wild animals for food and money is utterly abhorrent and should be punished by law.§我认为，为获取食物和金钱而猎杀珍稀野生动物的行径**可恶**至极，应该受到法律的制裁。§

23184§inflict§ɪnˈflɪkt§Doctors warned parents that daily life could inflict various injuries on children aged two or three.§医生警告父母：日常生活可能会给两三岁的儿童**造成**各种伤害。§改例句：书上写成 children could inflict injuries（儿童造成伤害），和译文「遭受伤害」意思相反，改成 inflict injuries on children；改译文：随例句改，inflict 是「造成」
23185§tilt§tɪlt§Government's fiscal policy will be tilting toward agricultural development.§政府的财政政策将**倾向**于农业发展。§
23186§offensive§əˈfensɪv§Every year, BBC receives plenty of complaints from the public about their offensive remarks during the interviews.§BBC每年都会收到公众对采访中出现的**冒犯性**话语的大量投诉。§

23187§jargon§ˈdʒɑːgən§If you take a presentation on some specific fields, to avoid confusing the audience, you should try to decrease jargon in your speech.§在做有关某一特定领域的报告时，为避免听众产生疑惑和不解，你应该尽量少用**术语**。§
23188§extravagant§ɪkˈstrævəgənt§The majority of people maintain that mass media has no rights to report the extravagant lifestyle and privacy of a star.§绝大多数人认为大众媒体无权报道明星**奢侈**的生活方式以及隐私。§
23189§begrimed§bɪˈgraɪmd§In recent years, more and more begrimed articles and videos have spread by means of the Internet and mobile phones.§近年来，越来越多内容**污秽**的文章和视频通过互联网和手机进行传播。§改例句：Internet 前缺冠词 the
23190§ruthless§ˈruːθləs§Most of the surveyed citizens argued that the government had shown a ruthless disregard for their basic human rights.§大部分接受调查的公民争论道，政府**残忍**地无视他们的基本人权。§
23191§diverse§daɪˈvɜːs§Millions of years ago, changes in the Earth's climate gave rise to diverse species in the tropical rain forest.§数百万年前，地球气候的变化导致了这片热带雨林物种的**多样**性。§
23192§extinguish§ɪkˈstɪŋgwɪʃ§This is non-smoking section. Please extinguish all cigarettes.§这里是非吸烟区，请将所有香烟**熄灭**。§
23193§estrange§ɪˈstreɪndʒ§If the government continues to increase the tax, it will estrange itself from the public in the end.§如果政府继续增加税收，终将**脱离**民众。§

23194§neoclassical§ˌniːəʊˈklæsɪkl§Besides grandeur of scale and simplicity of geometric forms, the use of columns is also the representative feature of neoclassical architecture.§除了规模的宏伟和几何形状的简洁性外，使用圆柱也是**新古典**建筑的标志性特征。§
23195§biased§ˈbaɪəst§Mothers might be biased to always think their children are the best in the world.§妈妈们可能有些**偏颇**，她们总是认为自己的孩子是世界上最棒的。§
23196§grimy§ˈgraɪmi§The increasingly serious air pollution is threatening the health of people living in the grimy industrial cities.§日益严重的空气污染正威胁着生活于**肮脏**的工业城市中的人们的健康。§

23197§enhancer§ɪnˈhɑːnsə(r)§Although not all people like the flavour of onion, ginger or garlic, they are good immune system enhancers.§尽管不是所有人都喜欢洋葱、姜、蒜的味道，但它们都具有极佳的**增强**免疫的功能。§改例句：主语 they 是复数，enhancer 应为 enhancers

23198§ulterior§ʌlˈtɪəriə(r)§In current society, when one actively supports someone who needs help, he may be suspected of having an ulterior motive by some people.§在当今社会，当一个人积极帮助需要帮助的人时，有些人可能怀疑他**别有**用心。§
23199§corrupt§kəˈrʌpt§People are usually annoyed by the sudden incident that the data on the hard drive of their computers is corrupted by the power cut.§电脑硬盘驱动器上的数据因断电而**损坏**，这类突发事件常常让人很恼怒。§
23200§stringent§ˈstrɪndʒənt§A stringent regulation on security has guaranteed the success of the Olympic Games.§**严格**的安保制度确保了奥运会的成功举办。§改例句：Olympic Games 前缺冠词 the

23201§novice§ˈnɒvɪs§Beginners might come out ahead in some cases because the novice is less stressed out about winning.§新手们在某些时候反而会领先，因为**新手**没有那么多必赢的心理压力。§改译文：原译把 the novice 译成「他们」，括不出 novice（新手），改为「新手」
23202§hinder§ˈhɪndə(r)§The survey reveals that most of the candidates' job applications have been hindered by their lack of relevant working experience.§调查显示，大部分求职者因缺乏相关的工作经验而导致其工作申请**受阻**。§
23203§tortoise§ˈtɔːtəs§People in that tribe used to think that the tortoises and turtles came from hell.§那个部落的人过去常认为**陆龟**和海龟来自地狱。§
23204§impoverished§ɪmˈpɒvərɪʃt§It is necessary to carry out the project of returning farmland to forests since overfarming has created much impoverished soil.§过度耕作已经造成了大量土地的**贫瘠**，所以必须实行退耕还林。§
23205§shallow§ˈʃæləʊ§To the elephant, the stream is quite shallow, so it is able to walk across it. But to the rabbit, it can be a murderer.§对大象来说，河流很**浅**，能够跨过去；但对兔子来说，就很危险，可能会被淹死。§
23206§inundate§ˈɪnʌndeɪt§Due to the successive heavy rain, the dam of the Nile breaks, which inundates large parts of the town and farmlands.§由于连降大雨，尼罗河大坝溃堤，**淹没**了该镇的大部分地区和农田。§
23207§erode§ɪˈrəʊd§The sharp increase in food price over the last few months has eroded the public's confidence in the government's policy.§过去几个月食品价格大幅上涨，**削弱**了公众对政府政策的信心。§
23208§doom§duːm§Some people hold that if this kind of rare animal is not well protected, it will be doomed to extinction.§一些人认为，如果这种珍稀动物得不到很好的保护，它**注定**会灭绝。§
23209§alienate§ˈeɪliəneɪt§Very talented people may feel alienated from the public.§天资出众的人可能觉得与大众**格格不入**。§

23210§commiserate§kəˈmɪzəreɪt§We deeply commiserated with job hunters who had lost their jobs.§我们对那些失去工作的求职者深表**同情**。§改例句：be on the loss of 不是英语说法，who were on the loss of their jobs 改为 who had lost their jobs
23211§outlaw§ˈaʊtlɔː§So far, the government's attempt to outlaw drunken driving has proved to be unsuccessful.§到目前为止，事实证明该政府试图使酒后驾车**成为非法**行为的努力失败了。§

23212§pavement§ˈpeɪvmənt§According to the report, 30% of graduates will spend about four months pounding the pavement in search of a job.§据报道，30%的毕业生要花大约四个月的时间奔波**街头**寻找一份工作。§改译文：pound the pavement 原译「四处奔波」括不出 pavement（人行道，路面），改为「奔波街头」
23213§antiquated§ˈæntɪkweɪtɪd§In comparison with modern mass media, ordinary radio looks positively antiquated.§与现代大众媒体相比，普通收音机肯定显得**过时**了。§
23214§coral§ˈkɒrəl§According to the research, with a big requirement of decoration, there is a falling number of coral in deep ocean in recent years.§据调查，由于装饰品的大量需求，近几年深海**珊瑚**数量锐减。§
23215§incinerate§ɪnˈsɪnəreɪt§The villages near the volcano were incinerated by the high temperatures generated by the eruption of magma.§火山附近的村子在岩浆喷发产生的高温中**化为灰烬**。§
23216§renewable§rɪˈnjuːəbl§Scientists all over the world have made utmost efforts to develop renewable energy sources such as wind and tide power.§全世界的科学家都竭尽全力开发风能和潮汐能等**可再生**能源。§
23217§shin§ʃɪn§This is a very inefficient way of running and a major cause of shin splints and heel pain.§这种跑步方式效率非常低，也是导致**胫骨**和足跟疼痛的主要原因。§
23218§enslave§ɪnˈsleɪv§Nowadays, more and more people have realized that they are being enslaved by the credit-card debt.§如今，越来越多的人意识到自己正沦为信用卡债务的**奴隶**。§
23219§timid§ˈtɪmɪd§Generally speaking, animals in the zoo are timid and cautious in comparison with wild animals in the forest.§一般而言，动物园的动物比森林中的野生动物**胆小**谨慎。§

23220§vile§vaɪl§Study shows that children who live in violent surroundings may use more vile language than ordinary children.§研究表明，与普通孩子相比，生活在暴力环境中的孩子可能会使用更多**肮脏**的语言。§改例句：指言辞时 language 不可数，languages 改为 language

23221§diesel§ˈdiːzl§Because of the development of new energies, fewer and fewer diesel engines are used in daily life.§由于新能源的开发，**柴油机**在日常生活中的使用日益减少。§改例句：engines 是可数名词复数，less and less 应为 fewer and fewer
23222§guzzle§ˈgʌzl§As its cars guzzle fuel, this car company has decreasing sales figures in recent years.§由于其生产的汽车**耗**油量太大，该汽车公司近几年的销售量一直在下滑。§
23223§torment§ˈtɔːment§It is hard for the rich to understand that the poor from the remote rural areas are undergoing a torment.§富人很难理解偏远农村地区的穷人正遭受着**苦难**。§
23224§revive§rɪˈvaɪv§In recent years, the government has encouraged folk artists to revive traditional skills by funding them.§近年来，政府已通过资金援助鼓励民间艺人**复兴**传统工艺。§
23225§inhumane§ˌɪnhjuːˈmeɪn§In sweatshops, skinny men, starved women and small minors are in the same inhumane conditions.§血汗工厂里，骨瘦如柴的男人、食不果腹的女人和瘦小的孩子都在同样**惨无人道**的环境中工作。§
23226§imperil§ɪmˈperəl§Some people think that the government's housing policy now might imperil the whole real estate market.§一些人认为政府的住房政策可能**危及**当下的整个房地产市场。§
23227§diverge§daɪˈvɜːdʒ§They had been living together for ten years, but then their paths diverged.§他们在一起生活了十年，但最后还是**分道扬镳**了。§

23228§irrational§ɪˈræʃənl§The theory that the earth revolves around the sun, put forward by Polish astronomer Copernicus, seemed to be somewhat irrational in the 15th century.§15世纪时，波兰天文学家哥白尼提出的地球绕着太阳运转的理论在当时似乎有点**荒谬**。§改例句：15th century 前缺冠词 the
23229§verbal§ˈvɜːbl§The engineer was too excited to give a verbal description of what the success of moon landing means.§工程师太兴奋了，以至于无法用**言语**表达登月成功意味着什么。§改例句：descrip-tion 是排版断行留下的连字符，改为 description
23230§saline§ˈseɪlaɪn§In medicine, saline is mainly used to kill bacteria. It is also widely used in cell biology experiments.§在医学中，**盐水**主要用于杀菌，还广泛应用于细胞生物学实验。§
23231§disable§dɪsˈeɪbl§There were so many people disabled and killed in the war.§这场战争造成了太多人的**伤残**和死亡。§
23232§seduce§sɪˈdjuːs§Customers were seduced into buying such household appliances as the washing machine and fridge by the offer of a free delivery.§顾客受商家免费送货的**利诱**而购买诸如洗衣机和冰箱之类的家电。§
23233§relocate§ˌriːləʊˈkeɪt§The factory is to relocate its headquarters in the coastal area, which would create redundancy of 60 workers.§工厂将把总部**迁往**沿海地区，这将导致60名员工失业。§
23234§angle§ˈæŋgl§When you are stuck by a problem, you should change the angle to find some valid solutions.§当你被一个难题卡住时，应该换一种**角度**去寻找有效的解决方法。§
23235§legitimate§lɪˈdʒɪtɪmət§The majority of scientists believe it is legitimate to use monkeys in medical research.§大多数科学家认为使用猴子进行医学研究是**合法**的。§
23236§sedentary§ˈsedntri§People doing sedentary jobs usually eat less than those who are in more active occupations.§从事**久坐**工作的人通常比那些从事活动量非常大的人吃得少。§
23237§water-borne§ˈwɔːtə bɔːn§Cholera, a water-borne disease, could cause severe diarrhea, vomiting and often death.§霍乱是一种由**水传播**的疾病，能引起严重的腹泻和呕吐，往往还导致死亡。§

23238§molten§ˈməʊltən§With the increasing activities of the inner earth, the earth was shaking, the sea was roaring, and the volcano was pouring out molten rock.§由于地球内部活动的不断加剧，地面在晃动，海水在咆哮，火山在不断地向外喷射**熔**岩。§
23239§processor§ˈprəʊsesə(r)§A word processor is the basic part of a computer to produce printed documents.§文字**处理器**是电脑制作印刷文件的基本部分。§
23240§saturate§ˈsætʃəreɪt§Since some Asian countries' investment markets have now been saturated, western countries are looking for a bigger market.§由于一些亚洲国家的投资市场现在已经**饱和**，西方国家正在寻求一个更大的市场。§
23241§trivialize§ˈtrɪviəlaɪz§There's a serious social problem today that too many films are trivializing the seriousness of violent and sex scenes.§当今有一个严重的社会问题，那就是过多影片都在**淡化**暴力以及情色场面的严重性。§
